body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: b71f2e5941f1dea80c05896362d8596500025fd8 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is our independent second review of the head. The earlier review
comments on this PR are the author's own markers.

What looks good:

- The change is wording only in effect. It changes no code path in
  `crates/post/src`. The Bake algorithm, the stored keys `bake` and
  `control`, and the project format are unchanged. No project-format
  bump is needed.
- `crates/app/src/schema.rs` keeps its component rules. The change is
  inside `WcsRotationOutput`: doc comments and the `label()` string. No
  field semantic changed.
- The `label()` string reaches only the UI picker text
  (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_options.rs:183` and `:186`). The posted
  output and the MCP tool use `word()`, which is unchanged
  (`crates/app/src/mcp/post_options_tools.rs:275`). This cannot change
  posted G-code.
- The new text agrees with what `post::wcs_rotate` already does, and the
  existing `bake_keeps_setup_table_coordinates_without_g68` test pins
  that behaviour. No second WCS derivation is added. The picker still
  writes through the undoable `SetPostOptions` command.
- The new pinning test is in the existing app test file, in line with
  the earlier Gate-map rule (#2361), and its Gate map names the added
  `post::engine` coverage. The decision record
  `docs/decisions/2359-bake-wording.md` follows the README format.

Results, built locally in an isolated worktree (head already contains
main `3e47b898b0148727979ff4a509f33a742f80ff1d`, so the trial merge is
clean):

- `camcraft-post` `wcs_rotate`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app` `wcs_rotation_control`: 5 passed, 0 failed. Includes
  the new `bake_label_agrees_with_posted_table_coordinates_at_nonzero_yaw`.
- `camcraft-ui` lib, run from `crates/ui`,
  `wcs_rotation_on_the_document_post_page_is_undoable`: 1 passed,
  0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-ui
  --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The diff touches no `build.rs`, no `.github/`, no `scripts/`, no
  `Cargo.toml`, no golden, and no snapshot PNG.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking):

- `crates/app/src/schema.rs` is 857 lines. It is already over the
  400-line file rule. This PR adds only a few lines to it. A future
  split is worth a look, not a change here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
